name: Arnoud Braun
bio: Arnoud is FarmTree's CEO. He focuses on the company's legal, administrative and sales work, drawing on his upbringing in Kenya and studies in tropical soil science at Wageningen.

name: Frank van Schoubroeck
bio: Frank conceptualised the FarmTree model after two decades of supporting smallholder farmers. He leads FarmTree's marketing, modelling and IT research and development.

name: Irene Vinkenburg
bio: Irene develops the FarmTree Model, translating science into code through dynamic modelling and maintaining and improving tools across the FarmTree Platform.

name: Roos van Haeff
bio: Roos works on agroforestry quantification and has contributed to the FarmTree Model and Platform since their inception. Her current work in East Africa emphasises water management and livelihoods.

name: Mia Beyens
bio: Mia supports the scientific integrity and documentation of the FarmTree Model and collaborates with the Innovation and IT teams on model development, validation and Platform functionality.

name: Ruben van Voorst
bio: Ruben supports database management and data collection, including ground-truth and calibrated agroforestry-system data. He studies Forest and Nature Management with a focus on tropical forestry.

name: Nikolaos Mantzaridis
bio: Nikolaos supports the creation of a library of calibrated species for the FarmTree Platform. He holds an MSc in Forest and Nature Conservation from Wageningen University.

name: Betelehem Beyene
bio: Betelehem builds client relationships, supports business development and helps clients get more from the FarmTree Platform. Her background is in private-sector development in Ethiopia's agricultural sector.

name: Edi Yoga
bio: Edi represents FarmTree in Indonesia's agroforestry and social-forestry sector. He specialises in soil geography and landscape dynamics.

name: Hery Hanipan
bio: Hery is a data scientist supporting the creation of FarmTree's calibrated species library, with particular attention to Asian entries.

name: Álvaro Mitcheletti
bio: Álvaro is an agroforestry modeller responsible for FarmTree's Spanish-, Portuguese- and French-language portfolio across projects in Latin America and Africa. He is based in Brazil.

name: Mary Theodorah Ajal
bio: Theodorah contributes to FarmTree's communications strategy and website management while studying Sustainable Food Systems at the Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences.

name: Crésus Odjo
bio: Crésus is an agronomy expert and FarmTree's representative in Bénin. His work includes technical support for land-restoration activities, monitoring and evaluation, and large-scale data collection.
